versions.content: Name Csm_ Config Id Type Kind Type Derived from uint16 Range 0..65535 -- -- Description Identification of a CSM service configuration via a numeric identifier, that is unique within a service. The name of a CSM service configuration, i.e. the name of the container Csm_<Service>Config, shall serve as a symbolic name for this parameter Available via Csm.h
